title: BOCCHI
unsupported_zone: Go to Occult Crescent (South or North Horn) to use BOCCHI.

support.kofi_tooltip: ♥ Ko-fi (so you can keep touching grass)

logs.copy_all_tooltip: Copy all BOCCHI logs (version, rotation, and recent lines for Discord support)

status.emergency_stop_tooltip: Emergency Stop — stop all automation, movement, and buffs
status.plugin_missing: {0} isn't running. This mode can't work without it.

pot_timer.unknown: Next pot: unknown. Do one pot FATE and BOCCHI will know the timer.

buffs.title: Buffs
buffs.apply_tooltip: Cast your configured buffs now. Stand in the knowledge crystal circle first.

completionist.mode_off_left_zone: [BOCCHI] Left Occult Crescent — Completionist Mode Off
completionist.description: Illegal Mode, but it only goes for FATEs and CEs whose field notes you are still missing. Survey points: click to mark one on the map, Ctrl+click to go there. Forked Tower notes are only listed.
completionist.legend: Check = unlocked · × = still needed · star = phantom job maxed
completionist.outside_zone: Enter South Horn or North Horn to see that zone’s field-note checklist.
completionist.survey_tooltip: Click to flag the map. Ctrl+click to travel there.
completionist.survey_tooltip_flag_only: Click to place a map flag. Ctrl+click travel needs the travel plugin ready for this zone.

sources.persistent_pots_nh: Daylight Pottery / In a Pot of Bother

automator.title: Illegal Mode
automator.refresh_pathfinding_tooltip: Drop the current route and plan a new one from where you are.
automator.rebuild_path_map_tooltip: Reload BOCCHI's path map of this zone. Try this if it can't find a route or stands still near camp.
automator.path_map_building: Building (Illegal Mode waits until this finishes)…
automator.path_map_rebuilding: [BOCCHI] Rebuilding path map for this zone…
automator.path_map_rebuild_wrong_zone: [BOCCHI] Rebuild path map only works in Occult Crescent.
automator.illegal_mode_off_left_zone: [BOCCHI] Left Occult Crescent — Illegal Mode Off
automator.illegal_mode_off_forked_tower: [BOCCHI] Entered the Forked Tower — Illegal Mode Off
automator.forked_tower_offer_ciphers: [BOCCHI] On the Forked Tower pad — offer Sanguine Ciphers at a cipher reliquary to register. Stay on the pad until you are teleported.
automator.forked_tower_on_pad: [BOCCHI] On the Forked Tower pad — stay here until you are teleported.
automator.pathfinding_refreshed_no_goal: [BOCCHI] Route cleared (nothing to go to right now)
automator.path_routing_failed: [BOCCHI] Couldn't find a route to that FATE or CE, so it is skipped for now. If this keeps happening, restart Illegal Mode or rebuild the path map.
automator.description: Does FATEs, Critical Encounters and Magic Pots for you, one after another.

why.stop_after_return: Paused: "Stop after return and teleport" is on, so you walk the rest yourself. Press Stop and Start for the next one.
why.nothing_allowed: Nothing to do: Do FATEs, Do Critical Encounters and the Magic Pot settings are all off.
why.waiting: Waiting for a FATE or Critical Encounter you allowed to come up.

mob_farmer.title: Mob Farmer
mob_farmer.configure_mobs: Choose which enemies to farm in the settings (the cog on this tab).
mob_farmer.off_left_zone: [BOCCHI] Left Occult Crescent — Mob Farmer Off
mob_farmer.description: Pulls the enemies you picked into a pack and fights them, over and over.

pots_treasure.pause_tooltip: Stop moving for now but keep your progress. Press Resume to continue.
pots_treasure.off_left_zone: [BOCCHI] Left Occult Crescent — Pots & Treasure Off
pots_treasure.description: Does every Magic Pot and its chests, and hunts treasure in between.
pots_treasure.requires_vnav: [BOCCHI] Pots & Treasure needs the travel plugin (vnavmesh).
pots_treasure.resume_treasure_hunt_tooltip: Don't wait: start another treasure hunt now.
pots_treasure.no_active_fate: No pot FATE up right now.

treasure.title: Treasure Hunter
treasure.waiting_navmesh: Waiting for the travel plugin to finish loading this zone…
treasure.start_hunt_tooltip: Walk to every bronze and silver coffer, open it, and skip the empty spots.
treasure.off_left_zone: [BOCCHI] Left Occult Crescent — Treasure Hunt Off
treasure.carrot_hunt_off_left_zone: [BOCCHI] Left Occult Crescent — Carrot Hunt Off
treasure.waiting_safe_window_detail: Paused for Ashkin or dangerous weather in South Horn. Continues when it is safe.
treasure.flag_resume_tooltip: Put a map flag on the coffer where the hunt will continue
treasure.recalculate_route_tooltip: Recalculate the treasure hunt route from your current position
treasure.managed_by_pots: This hunt is run by Pots & Treasure. Start or stop it on that tab.
treasure.managed_by_illegal_mode: This hunt is run by Illegal Mode, between activities.
treasure.managed_by_mob_farmer: This hunt is run by Mob Farmer, on its timer.
treasure.managed_by_carrot: A Carrot Hunt is running. Stop it below before you start a Treasure Hunt.
treasure.active_counts_idle: Cast Treasure Sight to see how many coffers are left.
treasure.carrot_hunt_description: Walks to every carrot spot, uses a Fortune Carrot and opens the bunny's chest.
treasure.use_fortune_carrot_tooltip: Use one Fortune Carrot right now. Helps when the hunt is stuck next to a carrot.
